{{Weapon infobox | type = Scepter | level = 80 | salvage = none | rarity = Legendary | uslot = Superior Sigil of Air | bound = account use | skin = Meteorlogicus (skin); Storm (skin); Tsunami (skin); Storm Experiment (skin) | prefix = selectable | id = 30695 | gallery1-text = Wielded during the day. | gallery2 = Meteorlogicus night.jpg | gallery2-text = Wielded during the night. | gallery3 = Meteorlogicus footfalls.jpg | gallery3-text = Stormy footfalls. }} [[Meteorlogicus]] is a [[Legendary weapon|legendary]] [[scepter]] crafted in the [[Mystic Forge]]. == Lore == {{Legendary unlock text|Meteorlogicus was designed by a [[sylvari]] astrologer, [[Surya]]—a love letter to the sky. She once used the orrery to trace a thunderous cloud that lurked on the horizon. She knew then: a [[Elder Dragon|dragon]] had awoken.}} == Acquisition == === Contained in === {{contained in}} === Recipe === {{Recipe | source = Mystic Forge | ingredient1 = 1 Storm | ingredient2 = 1 Gift of Meteorlogicus | ingredient3 = 1 Gift of Fortune | ingredient4 = 1 Gift of Mastery | quantity = 1 }} == Graphics == [[Meteorlogicus]] is a glowing [[w:orrery|orrery]] whose planets and clouds move. Sparkling stars emanate from the center glow. [[Meteorlogicus]] has a [[Day and night|day/night cycle]]. ; Day * Fluffy white clouds emanate from the base of the orrey. * The sun glows yellow, and a blue glow surrounds the entire scepter. * A blue trail follows the weapon when wielded, but not when stowed. ; Night * The clouds are dark, and lightning appears around them. * The sun glows violet, and a violet glow surrounds the entire scepter. * A violet trail follows the weapon when wielded and when stowed (after being drawn for the first time in a new area). ; Footfalls * The user leaves behind lightning bolts followed by dark clouds. ; Skill Effects * Default projectiles are replaced with a celestial stream of energy, which also leave a faint sparkling trail in its path. This effect replaces the following skills: **{{g}} [[Guardian]]: [[Orb of Wrath]]. ***{{dragonhunter}} [[Dragonhunter]]: [[Spear of Justice]]. **{{n}} [[Necromancer]]: [[Dhuumfire (death shroud skill)|Dhuumfire]], [[Dark Path]] and [[Life Blast]]. **{{e}} [[Elementalist]]: [[Fiery Frost]], [[Glacial Drift]], [[Hurl]], [[Ice Shards]], [[Stone Shards]], and [[Water Trident]]. ***{{tempest}} [[Tempest]]: [[Overload Fire]]'s whirl finisher. **{{m}} [[Mesmer]]: [[Ether Barrage]], [[Ether Blast]], [[Ether Bolt]], and [[Counterspell]]. **{{revenant}} [[Revenant]]: ***{{renegade}} [[Renegade]]: [[Citadel Bombardment]] **{{t}} [[Thief]]: ***{{specter}} [[Specter]]: [[Shadow Bolt]], [[Double Bolt]], [[Triple Bolt]], [[Shadow Sap]], [[Measured Shot]] === Gallery === File:Meteorlogicus concept art.jpg|Concept art by [[Kekai Kotaki]].
